entities.summary: Kyoto Prefectural University , Fudai (府大) or Kyōfudai (京府大) for short, is a public university in Japan. Its campus is located in Nakaragi-cho, Shimogamo, Sakyo-ku, Kyoto. Kyoto Prefectural University is a university in Asia, established in 1949. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
